content:
Odd days (April 1, 3, 5): 2 allowed cars each, so \(2^3=8\) choices.

Even days (April 2, 4): 3 allowed cars each, so \(3^2=9\) choices.

Jia’s car can be used at most once, so exclude the single even-day plan where Jia’s car is used on both even days: \(9-1=8\).

Total plans: \(8 \times 8 = 64\).

\boxed{64}
